:::"''I love opening chests. For me, the turning of the key is everything. I don't care much for what's inside. Perhaps you do? Here, since you're a good listener, the first coin's on me.''"

:"''Interested in my wares, are you?''"

:"''Ah, you are an acolyte of Melandru? In that case I'll ask you to scram. For my own nature is the only one I ever had any interest in serving, and if that has cost me the graces of the Gods, then so be it.''"

== Notes ==
* The Purveyor can be summoned in a mission or explorable area by using a [[Purveyor's Bell]]. This version of the Purveyor purely serves as a [[merchant]] and doesn't offer any other services.
** All keys offered are also available in pre-Searing, essentially adding another high-value currency aside of black dyes.
* Unlike the merchant summoned by the [[Mercantile Summoning Stone]], the Purveyor in an explorable area does not fight nor does it move with your party. If you want it to move to your location you must summon it again.
* You may still use a [[summoning stone]] in an explorable area after summoning the Purveyor.
* After being summoned, the Purveyor will turn toward the player who summoned it every few seconds.
{{anomaly|Unlike other summons, in explorable areas, the Purveyor seems to have no time limit.}}
